Lessons.Title: Round Numbers
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will round multi-digit whole numbers within 1,000,000 to the nearest 1,000, 10,000, and 100,000.
In grade 3, you rounded whole numbers to the nearest 10 and 100. In previous lessons, you worked to find the closest multiples of powers of 10. Here, you build on this work to round whole numbers to the nearest 1,000, 10,000, and 100,000.
Core relationship: Round whole numbers to a named place. Look at the next smaller place: 5–9 round up, 0–4 round down, preserving the target unit.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  Number Talk: Missing Numbers	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Round to What?	 (20 minutes); Activity 2:  Some Numbers to Round	 (15 minutes); Activity 3:  Rounded Populations	 [OPTIONAL] (20 minutes); Cool-down:  Round Three Ways	 (5 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: Rounded to the nearest 1,000, what is 46,580? Calculate its distance from 47,000.
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): Round 268,400 to the nearest 10,000.
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
